description: This file defines an interface 'WorkScheduleInterface' within the 'OrangeHRM\' namespace, specifying methods related to employee work schedules such as setting employee number, retrieving work shift length, start and end times, and checking various day types like holidays and non-working days.

classes.name: WorkScheduleInterface
classes.description: An interface that defines methods for managing and querying work schedule details for employees.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Set the employee number for the work schedule context.

methods.name: getWorkShiftLength
methods.description: Retrieve the length of the work shift in hours.

methods.name: getWorkShiftStartEndTime
methods.description: Get the start and end times of the work shift.

methods.name: isNonWorkingDay
methods.description: Determine if a given day is a non-working day.

methods.name: isHalfDay
methods.description: Check if a given day is a half working day.

methods.name: isHoliday
methods.description: Check if a given day is a holiday.

methods.name: isHalfDayHoliday
methods.description: Check if a given day is a half-day holiday.
